question: Six boxes A, B, C, D, E and F are arranged in a vertical column but not necessarily in the same order. B is placed at second position from the top. Only D is placed between A and B. E is at one of the positions below D and there is only one box between E and D. F is not at the bottom most position. Which box is placed at second position from the bottom?
